label: Diagram 16
caption: Diagram 16 An example of a shared refreshment facility | Sleeping accommodation
description: This is a front elevation illustrating a shared refreshment facility. The drawing shows a worktop with several appliances. At the top, a label "Clear space under worktop" points down to the worktop, and a "Floor unit" is indicated on the right. On the left, a vertical dimension of "80mm" is shown. Below this, a "Microwave oven" is depicted as a rectangle within a counter section. The main worktop is shown across the centre, featuring a sink with a tap and a hob drawn as a rectangle with horizontal lines and a control dial. A label indicates the "Work surface 850mm above floor level", and another points to the "Refrigerator under worktop". On the right side, a swing-out shelf is drawn, projecting from the counter. At the bottom, a "Floor unit" is marked, and the bottom right corner is labelled as a "1500mm x 1500mm Wheelchair turning space".
